visualCharacteristics: Subscription tiers shown side by side as white cards with brand line, tier name, feature label/value pairs, price and order button; on mobile the tabs variant shows one tier at a time behind tab buttons.
contentPattern: A comparison table with one column per tier: a one-cell heading row for the title, a name row (brand line or logo plus bold tier name), one feature row per attribute (label, line break, bold value, optional :information-circle:), and an order row with the price paragraph and a bold CTA link. With tabs, the first multi-cell row holds the tab labels.
usage: Use to compare subscription tiers or plans side by side with features, prices and order buttons.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any plan/tier comparison by adding one column per tier; add tabs for long tier lists on mobile.
